map.配比逻辑：非交联透明质酸为基底（占 50%，若含 PRP 则降为 30%）；PR: Ratio logic: non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid as base (50%, or 30% if PRP is included); PRP 30%, vitamin C 10%, peptides / growth factors 5% (0.5%), micro-botulinum 2% (~5 U/ml, ≤30 U full face), PDRN 15% (cap 2 ml), glutathione 3% (600 mg/4 ml). Saline = total − sum of ingredient volumes, used to top up the total (counted when >0.1 ml). At least HA or PRP must be chosen as a base. Used for hydration-injection formula ingredient and dosage accounting.
